name: machinebox-videobox
description: Videobox extracts frames from videos and passes them to other Machine Box boxes for processing.

ports.name: MB_PORT
ports.description: (string) Defaults to 8080 - Port where the service will listen.

variables.name: MB_ADDRESS
variables.description: (string) Defaults to 0.0.0.0 - Address where the service will listen.

variables.name: API_KEY
variables.description: Container Variable: MB_KEY Get one here https://machinebox.io/login

variables.name: MB_DISABLE_CORS
variables.description: (bool) Defaults to false - If true will turn off CORS support for the box.

variables.name: MB_BASICAUTH_USER
variables.description: (string) The Basic Authentication username and password that every request must use. Recommended for sitautions where the boxes are publicly accessible.

variables.name: MB_VIDEOBOX_RESULT_DURATION
variables.description: Defaults to 1h (one hour) - Amount of time to keep the results before automatically deleting them
